body: End-to-end testing of Field Notes on the Galaxy Note 10+ and macOS is complete, and every defect it found is fixed and verified live, apart from two items the owner deferred.U+000AU+002D Android and macOS journeys ran with results recorded in testkit/E2E-REPORT.md.U+000AU+002D The fixes shipped through the specs android-macos-e2e-fixes and live-check-findings, in PRs #212 to #226.U+000AU+002D The post-merge live checks passed on the Mac sandbox and on the phone.U+000AU+002D The branch feat/composer-editor-core merged into main as PR #227 (caf724a), whose tree is identical to the verified head f5d6f12: analysis clean, 3,424 tests passing, CI green.U+000AU+002D Deferred by the owner and recorded as out of scope: the Japanese select-all kana leftover in the note editor, and the flaky tooling test android_dump_rules_test.dart.U+000AU+002D Cleanup on 2026-09-28: 72 merged or scratch worktrees and 67 merged branches removed; the checkout moved to main with the owner's drive.sh change intact; the test build uninstalled from the phone; the VM shut down.
